build_nose_hoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat to run NVT molecular dynamics at a target temperature
build_bussi_thermostat: build a Bussi stochastic velocity rescaling thermostat for NVT ensemble simulations
build_langevin_thermostat: build a Langevin thermostat with configurable friction for stochastic dynamics simulations
build_berendsen_npt_thermostat: build a BerendsenNPT thermostat for constant pressure and temperature simulations
save_restore_thermostat_state: save and restore thermostat state for checkpointing molecular dynamics simulations
